stem: Based on the information presented in the essay, what is one message the reader can infer?

options.label: A
options.text: Avoiding competition is better than participating when failure is certain.

options.label: B
options.text: Being rewarded simply for participating belittles the efforts of the winners.

options.label: C
options.text: Persistence ensures that a loser will eventually become a winner.

options.label: D
options.text: Satisfaction comes from being dedicated and doing your best.
